parts.label: Tăng tốc
parts.text: Động cơ đẩy máy bay chạy nhanh trên đường băng.

parts.label: Nhấc lên
parts.text: Phi công nâng mũi; cánh tạo đủ lực nâng để máy bay rời đường băng.

calls.title: Máy bay cất cánh

parts.label: Four chambers
parts.text: The upper chambers fill; the lower chambers squeeze blood out.

parts.label: Right side
parts.text: The right side receives oxygen-poor blood from the body and pumps it to the lungs.

parts.label: Left side
parts.text: The left side receives oxygen-rich blood from the lungs and pumps it to the body.

parts.label: Valves
parts.text: Valves keep blood moving in one direction as the heart relaxes and contracts.

calls.title: How the heart pumps blood

parts.label: Stamens
parts.text: The male parts: anthers produce pollen, supported by filaments.

parts.label: Pistil
parts.text: The female part includes the stigma, style and ovary.

calls.title: Main parts of a flower

parts.label: Earth
parts.text: We see the Moon from Earth.

parts.label: New moon
parts.text: The Moon is between Earth and the Sun; its lit side faces mostly away from us.

parts.label: Quarter moon
parts.text: We see half of the Moon’s sunlit side.

parts.label: Full moon
parts.text: Earth is between the Sun and Moon, so we see nearly all of its sunlit side.

parts.label: Quarter moon
parts.text: We again see half of the sunlit side, on the opposite side from the first quarter.

calls.title: Why the Moon has phases
